profiles.rule: Use the existing zero-joint stance goal, which equals BW5R-B's zero-amplitude pose. Preserve V18 recovery before stance and the current 0.1-second response, 0.5 measured-velocity damping, 0.75 rad/s stance speed cap, impulse caps, gates and timeouts. No geometry_rule_id means the existing STANCE_TARGETS_RAD, not a new angle fit.
profiles.parameter_basis: A distinct combination: the earlier undamped neutral stance lost foot support; the later damped stance used flexed knees. Test neutral stance with the existing damping and world-vertical recovery, without assuming stability or claiming it explains V23's later losses.
